turns.question: What share of non-cancelled order revenue between 17 August and 2 October 2026 came from orders that have no return at all, in percent?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no metric for the share of non-cancelled order revenue from orders with no return, so I cannot give that percentage. The closest metrics are Revenue (EUR), Net revenue (EUR) and Return rate, and Return rate counts returned orders over orders rather than revenue. Fresh: returns.silver is ready up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z. Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
